# Incident Report: S-TUN-003 Alarms Investigation

- **Classification:** no_impact
- **Root cause:** no_impact at `S-TUN-003`
- **Confidence:** high (Directly evidenced by alarms (T3) and normal KPIs (T4), with detector anomalies (T1), changes (T5), maintenance (T6), and external events (T7) checked and ruled out.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-20 20:53 to 2026-09-20 21:51
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-20 20:53
- **Affected:** S-TUN-003

## Summary

Site S-TUN-003 experienced transient, self-clearing minor and warning alarms (VSWR_HIGH and TEMP_HIGH) due to benign environmental and antenna/feeder fluctuations during peak traffic, while KPIs remained entirely normal.

No service degradation or impact on users; all 23 alarms cleared within minutes and KPIs matched baselines.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-20 20:53: Minor VSWR_HIGH alarms started raising on S-TUN-003. [ALM-000430, T3]
- 2026-09-20 20:57: Warning TEMP_HIGH alarms started raising on S-TUN-003. [ALM-000431, T3]
- 2026-09-20 21:51: All alarms on S-TUN-003 cleared. [ALM-000430, ALM-000431, T3]

## Evidence

- Site S-TUN-003 raised 23 self-clearing, non-critical alarms including minor VSWR_HIGH and warning TEMP_HIGH between 2026-09-20 20:53 and 21:51. [ALM-000430, ALM-000431, T3]
- KPIs including availability, active users, download volume, and drop rate showed no deviation from baseline. [T4]
- No configuration changes or maintenance windows occurred on S-TUN-003 or its parents during the observation window. [T5, T6]
- No external events were reported for the region. [T7]

## Hypotheses

1. **no_impact** at S-TUN-003: confirmed. Alarms were transient and self-clearing without any impact on KPIs, configuration changes, or maintenance. [T3, T4, T5, T6, T7]

## Ruled out

- ALM-000430: Ruled out as a service-impacting issue because all 11 minor VSWR_HIGH occurrences self-cleared within minutes and KPIs remained completely normal.
- ALM-000431: Ruled out as a service-impacting issue because all 12 warning TEMP_HIGH occurrences self-cleared and KPIs showed no degradation.

## Recommended actions

- Continue standard monitoring of site S-TUN-003.

## Sources

- `ALM-000430`: minor VSWR_HIGH on S-TUN-003, 11 occurrences from 2026-09-20 20:53 .. 21:51; all cleared
- `T3`: get_alarms(start=2026-09-20 18:00:00, end=2026-09-21 08:26:00, node_ids=['S-TUN-003'], include_descendants=True) -> 23 alarm(s) on S-TUN-003 and nodes below, 2026-09-20 18:00 to 2026-09-21 08:26: 11 minor, 12 warning; 0 active at asked_at (2026-09-21 08:26).

- `T5`: get_changes(start=2026-09-20 18:00:00, end=2026-09-21 08:26:00, node_ids=['S-TUN-003'], include_ancestors=True) -> No changes on S-TUN-003 and its parents between 2026-09-20 18:00 and 2026-09-21 08:26.
